def solve_total(entry):
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return None
    places = entry.get("places")
    if not isinstance(places, list):
        return None

        if not isinstance(p, int) or isinstance(p, bool) or p < 1:

    bonus = entry.get("bonus", 0)
    if not isinstance(bonus, int) or isinstance(bonus, bool) or bonus < 0:

    if "drop" in entry and "discard" in entry:

    drop = 0

    if not isinstance(drop, int) or isinstance(drop, bool) or drop < 0:
        return None
    scores = sorted([base_points(p) for p in places], reverse=True)
    keep = len(scores) - drop
    if keep < 0:
        keep = 0
    return bonus + sum(scores[:keep])
